args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The nightly tests expect banker's rounding, but round_money was using
ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 -> 2.66 and
2.675 -> 2.68 as required by FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly test failure in `tests/test_money.py` (2.665 was rounding to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha 08d3cd59): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

transcript.reasoning_content:
The docstring already says ROUND_HALF_EVEN but code uses ROUND_HALF_UP. Test expects: 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66. Let's check: 2.675 with HALF_EVEN: the digit before is 7 (odd) → rounds up to 2.68. Wait, quantize on Decimal("2.675") — but 2.675 is exactly representable as Decimal. 2.675 → half even: last kept digit 7 is odd, so round up → 2.68. ✓. 2.665 → last kept digit 6 is even, so round down → 2.66. ✓. So ROUND_HALF_EVEN satisfies the test.

Fix: change ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Create branch, commit, run CI, wait, open PR, merge. Merging requires code-owner approval — the PR will route to code owner. The task says merge it; I'll attempt merge and if approval is required, the system routes it.
